audit.whatIsWrong: The page is tagged HARD but rates itself 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' against a 34.29% win rate.
audit.why: Ornn's passive gives him bonus armour and MR from every source, so Karma's magic chip is soaked from level 1, and he self-forges health items she cannot out-scale. The prose already calls the late game unwinnable; only the numbers disagreed.
audit.corrected: diffRating 8/10, carryRating 8/10, both difficulty sentences reworded to match the HARD tag.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Karma while its own why calls it 'a genuinely contested, skill-based moment'; Level 2 was Skill while its why describes Ornn chaining CC and winning the trade-back; Level 6 was given to Karma while its why says 'the power gap widens hard at 6'.
audit.why: Ornn gains a real ultimate at 6 and Karma's Mantra has been up since level 1 — that is a relative loss, not a Karma stage. The packet levelChart agrees on all three rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 4 flipped in matched pairs to Skill, Ornn, Ornn, giving the full chart Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every mention of Searing Charge says it knocks up 'into a wall'. Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is itself terrain, so Ornn can create his own wall in open lane and does not need a side wall at all.
audit.why: Told the current way, a player thinks standing in the middle of the lane is safe from the knock-up. Q (9/8.5/8/7.5/7s) into E is the self-sufficient setup, and it is the interaction that actually kills Karma.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d names Q's cooldown and the pillar; dontsFull[0].d states that the pillar is his own wall.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'The Focused Resolve' as a suspect name; Focused Resolve is Karma's own W and is used correctly in the mid text. False positive, no edit.

edits.before: Pillar + knockup setup — stay off walls and sidestep the line. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s and builds the pillar his E knocks you into — sidestep the line first.

notes: The 'Brittle-amplified auto stuns' claim already on the page is not in Riot's kit text (Bellows Breath only says enemies 'become Brittle'), so I left it as written rather than restate or remove it — recorded as unverified. The page's repeated 'into a wall' framing for Searing Charge understated the threat: Volcanic Rupture's pillar is terrain, so he supplies his own wall mid-lane.
